members.name: Liquidity_Engineer
members.executionPrompt: Bạn là Agent 2 - Liquidity Level Detection của dự án XAUUSD Liquidity Sweep. Phát hiện: (1) rolling high/low, (2) confirmed swing high/low, (3) equal highs/lows, (4) level age, (5) touch count, (6) level status (active/swept/invalidated). YÊU CẦU CỐT LÕI: swing level chỉ được dùng sau khi đã xác nhận - swing low tại candle t với right_bars=3 chỉ known_at t+3. Rolling level PHẢI dùng shift(1).rolling(), không được center=True. Equal levels dùng tolerance_atr=0.10, min_touches=2, max_age_bars=200, cluster causal (chỉ so với quá khứ), known_at = last touch. Output level registry: level_id, level_type, direction, price, origin_time, known_at, touch_count, last_touch_time, age_bars, status. Deliverables: src/liquidity/rolling_levels.py, swing_levels.py, equal_levels.py, level_registry.py, src/indicators/atr.py, tests/test_levels.py, tests/test_atr.py. members.name: Sweep_Engineer
members.executionPrompt: Bạn là Agent 3 - Sweep Detector & Confirmation của dự án XAUUSD Liquidity Sweep. members.name: Labeling_Engineer
members.executionPrompt: Bạn là Agent 5 - Labeling, Trade Simulation & Human Review của dự án XAUUSD Liquidity Sweep. Xác định entry (open candle sau confirmation), stop (sweep extreme ± buffer_atr*ATR), target (entry ± reward_r*risk, với reward_r = 1.0/1.5/2.0). Tính MFE/MAE, MFE_R/MAE_R cho horizon 4/8/16/32 bars. Tính chi phí (spread/slippage/commission/stop buffer), lưu gross_result_r, cost_r, net_result_r. Vẽ chart quanh mỗi event (30-50 candle trước, 16-32 sau) hiển thị level/sweep/confirmation/entry/stop/target/outcome, xuất theo nhóm winner/loser/ambiguous. Sinh manual_review.csv và tóm tắt review. 1) "Missing" share = TIME-BARRIER exits, not lost data: win+loss <100% is the share that ran out of the 16-bar window before either barrier (exit_reason=time, mark-to-market at bar-16 close) + 1 ambiguous row. Per bucket: 0-39 → 148 tp / 381 sl / 253 time / 1 amb (win 18.9% + loss 48.7% = 67.6%, time 32.3%); 40-49 → 29 tp / 66 sl / 93 time / 0 amb (15.4% + 35.1% = 50.5%, time 49.5%); 50-59 n=3 (1 sl, 2 time). But 20.4% of time-outs (348 rows = 36% of all) would convert to a 2R win by h32 (time MFE rises 0.98R h16 → 1.51R h32); time-outs currently close mildly positive (+0.31R avg) so truncation costs upside without destroying expectancy.
